product_summary: Website movilimpex.com (Ahmedabad, B 710 Titanium Business Park, Makarba) states: 'Global exporters of Indian spec mobile phones. Dealing in Apple, Xiaomi, Samsung, Motorola.' Products page lists only four brand names — Apple, Xiaomi, Samsung, Motorola — with no models, no specs, no catalogue, no prices, no HS codes. Also claims 'other consumer electronics' and 'ready stocks in key locations overseas', but no product line for that is shown. No customs line, invoice or B/L is published on the site, so the entire product range is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
comment: HS: declared 851712 is the pre-2022 subheading 'Telephones for cellular networks or for other wireless networks'. Since the HS-2022 revision this line was split and smartphones now fall under 851713 ('Smartphones'), with other cellular phones under 851714. Because the site explicitly describes the goods as mobile phones/smartphones (Apple, Xiaomi, Samsung, Motorola), the correct current HS-6 is 851713; the declared 851712 is a legacy/outdated code, not a wrong product family — hence 'partial', not 'wrong'. Per project rule 3 the company is kept and the code corrected to 851713 (851714 only if feature phones are also shipped — not evidenced). Industry classification 'IT и электроника' is broadly consistent with the declared goods, but the site shows a pure trading/export operation (no manufacturing, no plant, no brand of its own, 'large buying power', 'ready stocks overseas'), so role = trader, not manufacturer. Product lines missing from the declaration: 'other consumer electronics' is mentioned in the About text but never itemised — if shipped, it would fall outside 8517 (e.g. 8518 headphones, 8504 chargers, 8471 computers) and would need separate codes; cannot be verified. Legal-form discrepancy: the request names 'Movil Impex Pvt. Ltd' while the website consistently says 'Movil Impex LLP' — a Pvt Ltd and an LLP are different legal entities; the site gives no CIN/LLPIN, so the entity identity is unconfirmed (registry check out of scope for this role). No PAN, no GST, no IEC published on the site. No shipment records, dates or destinations published — 'следов поставок не найдено' on the public web presence; the brand list is a claim only. Sources: https://movilimpex.com , https://movilimpex.com/about , https://movilimpex.com/products .
